title: hepetis ensifolia
intro: Hepetis ensifolia, commonly known as Chinese Chaste Tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Oleaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries, valued for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to relieve menstrual irregularities, improve cardiovascular health, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Hepetis ensifolia include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and estrogenic activities, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
